_comment: Curated corrections to sheet "1. Ingredients" of the v6 workbook, keyed by source_ref and merged into the generated rows by scripts/convert-v6-workbook.py. `default_unit_code` and `purchase_unit_code` are merged where an entry states one; everything else a row carries still comes from the sheet. This is an input to the conversion rather than an output of it, in the same way packaging-overlay.json is. The workbook itself is not in this repository, so the same changes have ALSO been applied by hand to the committed platform-ingredients.json — the overlay is what makes them survive the next regeneration, not what produced the committed rows.
_source: The owner's unit table, September 2026: every ING row stocks in KG or LTR. Thirteen rows are LTR (citric acid, the vinegars, the waters, soya sauce, vanilla syrup, condensed milk, full-fat milk); the other 293 are KG. The five edible oils were considered for LTR and deliberately left in KG — nutrition already resolves for a mass row, and moving them would restate every oil line in the recipe book to satisfy a purchasing convention.
